Job Summary

In enterprise security, no product wins alone. Identity has become the critical framework linking cloud infrastructure, security applications, and automation. As organizations rapidly adopt AI agents and autonomous machine workflows, securing how these systems interact is the most critical challenge in modern technology.

As Senior Product Manager for Technology Alliances, you will define how the Idira platform connects with the broader enterprise technology ecosystem. Your primary mission is leading our AI and machine solution partnerships, driving horizontal strategy across the entire portfolio.

You will operate strategically across three ecosystem tracks: our internal engineering speedboat team, external partners building directly on our platform, and core product lines embedding integrations into their roadmaps. We are looking for a fast product builder who thrives in ambiguity, establishes cross-organizational alignment with ease, and makes excellent product calls.

  • Ecosystem Roadmap: Define product direction and author technical requirements for both internal engineering builds and external partner developers by translating signals from customers and the field into a prioritized integration backlog.
  • Market Research: Continuously evaluate the fast-moving AI, machine learning, and automated agent identity landscapes, identifying high-value technology trends and net-new integration opportunities.
  • Drive Technology Partnerships: Lead the product strategy for strategic technology alliances. Partner closely with the business development managers who own the business relationship.
  • Cross Functional Alignment: Partner with core product management leaders across the enterprise to synchronize roadmaps, delivery timelines, and launch plans, creating a unified strategy across all products.
  • Bring Integrations to Market: Collaborate closely with internal teams such as product marketing to ensure Sales, Customer Success, and Sales Engineers are fully equipped to position, demonstrate, and implement new integrations to drive customer adoption.
  • Measure Ecosystem Adoption: Own the framework for tracking how customers interact with our ecosystem. Monitor and analyze integration usage data, identify trends in customer adoption, and connect these product health insights directly to broader platform growth and retention goals.

Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS, with a proven track record of owning a product roadmap from concept to launch
  • Direct experience managing integration products, APIs, or platform extensibility frameworks
  • Proven ability to operate across partners, engineering, sales, and executive leadership simultaneously without losing momentum
  • Superb communication skills, both in writing and in conversation, across highly technical and business audiences
  • Experience in technology alliances, partner programs, or ecosystem focused product roles is a strong plus
  • Deep familiarity with enterprise identity security, container platforms like Kubernetes, and modern DevOps pipelines where automated machine workloads are deployed is a plus
  • Knowledge of AI platform integrations or AI native technology partners is a distinct advantage

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

As a Principal Product Analyst, you will transform product usage, customer behavior, and business insights into recommendations that influence roadmap decisions, improve customer outcomes, and drive product adoption.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, and Customer Success, you will define trusted product metrics, leverage AI to accelerate analysis and uncover insights, and enable data-informed decision-making across the Cortex portfolio.

Your Impact

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define product success metrics and answer strategic business questions.

  • Analyze product usage and customer behavior using data and AI to identify opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and customer outcomes.

  • Translate complex datasets into actionable insights that influence product strategy and roadmap decisions.

  • Define and maintain trusted product KPIs, executive dashboards, and scalable measurement frameworks.

  • Partner with Engineering and Product Management to ensure high-quality product instrumentation and analytics.

  • Leverage AI-powered analytics and automation to improve insight generation, reporting efficiency, and decision-making.

  • Champion analytics and AI best practices to foster a culture of data-informed product development.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Business Intelligence, Product Management, or a similar role in a B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Proven experience using data to influence product strategy and business decisions.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience defining KPIs and measuring product success.

  • Experience leveraging AI tools and modern analytics platforms to accelerate analysis, generate insights, and improve decision-making.

  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with BI and visualization tools.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leaders.

  • Strong ownership and the ability to drive complex initiatives independently.

  • Advantage: Experience in cybersecurity, cloud, or enterprise SaaS products.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Job Summary

Our engineering team is at the core of how modern data security is built. We are redefining how organizations understand and protect their most sensitive data in a world of growing scale, speed, and complexity. By combining high-performance systems with intelligent, AI-driven capabilities, we challenge traditional approaches and push the boundaries of what data classification can achieve.

We’re looking for engineers who thrive in open-ended environments, are energized by hard problems, and are motivated to build solutions that don’t yet exist. This role is about more than writing code. It’s about shaping how intelligent systems detect, interpret, and protect data across cloud and endpoint environments.

In this role, you will play a central part in designing and building a core classification engine that powers multiple security solutions across the platform. Your work will directly influence how different products identify risk, enforce protection, and operate at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of large-scale systems and applied AI, turning raw signals into accurate, reliable insights that help customers secure their data with confidence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and scale AI-driven data classification and detection capabilities for next-generation data security products.

  • Design systems that identify, classify, and protect sensitive data in real time across cloud and endpoint environments.

  • Lead technical design discussions and influence architecture for large-scale data processing systems.

  • Partner with product, infrastructure, and other engineering teams to deliver tightly integrated solutions.

  • Solve complex engineering challenges related to scale, performance, reliability, and operations.

  • Raise the technical and collaborative bar by mentoring, sharing knowledge, and improving team practices.

  • Proactively suggest ideas, lead initiatives, and drive continuous improvement across the product and engineering processes.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer.

  • BSc degree in Computer Science, or equivalent background.

  • Proven ability to design and deliver complex systems end-to-end.

  • Strong algorithmic thinking, including the ability to design efficient solutions under real-world constraints such as scale, latency, and resource usage.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

  • Ability to “make things work” beyond writing good code - hands-on, practical, and execution-oriented.

  • Strong ownership, communication skills, and a proactive mindset.
     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience with Rust - a significant advantage, though willingness to work in Rust is also relevant.

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models into production systems, with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability.

  • Python or Go experience in a large-scale cloud environment.

  • Experience with applications running remotely at scale.

  • Familiarity with cyber technologies, information security, software security, or related domains.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at  accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Job Summary

Your Career:

We are seeking a high-impact Sr. Staff Software Engineer to drive technical strategy, execution, and delivery within our Data & AI Platform team. In this role, you will architect cloud-native infrastructure, establish R&D best practices, and consistently ship high-ROI platform services that power core solutions for both internal systems and enterprise clients.

Your Impact:

  • Technical Leadership & Delivery: Define R&D engineering standards and architecture principles while taking full ownership of end-to-end delivery for complex, production-ready initiatives.

  • Cloud & Data Architecture: Architect and build scalable, highly available solutions across major cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) leveraging modern data, streaming, serverless, and storage platforms.

  • AI-Driven Engineering: Integrate modern AI tools and autonomous agents into daily workflows to optimize development velocity, author reusable agent skills, and maintain contextual grounding for maximum efficiency.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Lead all phases of an AI-augmented Software Development Life Cycle (ASDLC)—from architectural design through automated testing, CI/CD deployment, and operations.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product leaders and technical stakeholders to translate complex business needs into clear, high-value software deliverables shipped on schedule.

  • Mentorship & Culture: Elevate engineering standards across the org through architectural guidance, code reviews, and continuous knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • High-Level Language Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience building production-grade software in languages such as Python, Java, Go, C#, or Scala.

  • Cloud Engineering: 2+ years designing and deploying cloud-native solutions on major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Proven Delivery Record: Demonstrated track record of taking complex software products from initial design to production delivery with measurable business impact.

  • AI Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience using modern AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) and productivity agents to accelerate technical output.

  • SDLC / ASDLC Mastery: Strong expertise navigating full lifecycle software development, with a clear advantage for candidates experienced in an Agentic SDLC (ASDLC) environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Serverless Architectures: Experience designing event-driven, serverless systems (e.g., AWS Lambda, Cloud Functions, EventBridge).

  • Data & Messaging Ecosystems: Experience with modern storage platforms (e.g., Apache Iceberg, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redis, Graph DBs) and messaging systems (e.g., SQS, RabbitMQ, MSK, or cloud equivalents).

  • Agentic Engineering: Hands-on experience building or deploying AI agents, structuring context/prompt pipelines, or authoring custom AI skills.

  • Advanced Degree: Master’s degree in Computer Science or a quantitative field

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at  accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

Your Career:

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to serve as a technical anchor for our Identity Authentication engineering team. Driving the modernization of core, mission-critical authentication domains across our primary product, delivering massive impact at scale. You will drive the architectural design, technical roadmap, and implementation of high-throughput, mission-critical SaaS services using AWS architecture, AWS CDK, and .NET. In addition to technical execution, you will mentor engineers, guide design decisions across teams, and ensure our systems satisfy demanding scalability, security, and performance standards (NFRs).

Your Impact:

  • Architectural Leadership: Drive end-to-end design and system architecture for enterprise-grade Identity & User Management cloud services.
  • Technical Strategy: Partner with Product Managers and Security Architects to translate complex identity and cybersecurity requirements into scalable software architecture.
  • Engineering Standards: Elevate technical excellence across the team by setting standards for code quality, resilience, telemetry, and automated testing.
  • Mentorship & Growth: Technical coaching and mentoring for mid-level and senior engineers to foster team growth and best practices.
  • Innovation & Problem Solving: Solve complex system bottlenecks, evaluate emerging tech stacks, and optimize AWS infrastructure costs and performance.

Qualifications

Your Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience / IDF elite technology unit alumni.
  • 8–12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of designing and delivering enterprise cloud SaaS applications.
  • Deep expertise in .NET / C# (or Java/Go/Python) within distributed cloud environments.
  • Strong background in microservice and event-driven architecture (event buses, pub/sub, asynchronous workflows).
  • Demonstrated experience owning critical subsystem architectures from design through production scale.
  • Excellent cross-team communication, technical writing, and mentoring skills.

Preferred Qualifications :

  • Extensive experience with AWS ecosystems and Infrastructure-as-Code (AWS CDK, Terraform).
  • Deep understanding of Identity & Access Management concepts (directory services, RBAC/ABAC, SSO, OAuth2/OIDC, SAML).
  • Hands-on experience with high-scale container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) and robust CI/CD systems.
  • Build end-to-end features using models from providers like Open AI, Anthropic, or open-source ecosystems.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

  • Lead by example through high-impact implementation, mentoring engineers, and helping them navigate complex technical tradeoffs.

  • Proactively identify critical technical problems or gaps, and drive solutions from concept through delivery.

  • Establish and promote engineering best practices, ensuring high standards for code quality, security, and operational excellence.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, architects, product managers, and stakeholders, influencing decisions, fostering alignment, and driving cross-team collaboration.

  • You have experience or a strong interest in identity, authentication, authorization, and secrets management, and you’re excited to apply these principles to AI and agent frameworks—this will give you an edge.

  • You thrive in ambiguity, make high-impact technical decisions, and guide others through complex tradeoffs with confidence.

Your Impact

As a Senior Principal DevOps Engineer, you will serve as a visionary technical leader within the Cortex Cloud DevOps group. You will define the technical strategy and architecture that ensures our massive-scale production services remain highly reliable, exceptionally secure, and performant. You will pioneer the integration of AI-driven capabilities into our daily operations, establishing elite engineering standards and fundamentally transforming the workflows of hundreds of developers through autonomous agents and intelligent procedures.

Your Career

  • Architectural Vision & Scalability: Design and scale massive, resilient distributed systems and global Kubernetes infrastructure, implementing robust observability and monitoring frameworks.

  • AI-Driven Transformation: Revolutionize the SDLC by integrating Generative AI, autonomous agents, and LLM-powered workflows into CI/CD and self-healing systems to accelerate developer velocity.

  • Technical Leadership & IaC: Define architectural standards, lead GitOps/IaC (FluxCD/Terraform) strategies, and mentor Senior/Staff engineers across the R&D organization.

  • Developer Experience & Efficiency: Build and champion AI-powered platforms that automate troubleshooting and eliminate friction. Partner directly with Engineering Directors, Principal Architects, and Product Management to align infrastructure initiatives with business goals, optimizing for scale, high availability, and multi-million-dollar cost-efficiencies.

  • Security & Compliance: Embed "Security by Design" principles into the platform architecture to ensure platform integrity without sacrificing delivery speed.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform, or Infrastructure Engineering roles, with a significant portion at the principal/ tech leadership/ staff, or architectural level.

  • System Design from Scratch: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying large-scale, highly available distributed systems and cloud platforms from the ground up.

  • AI-Powered Automation: Proven experience designing and integrating AI-driven systems, autonomous agents, and LLM-based tools into engineering workflows to optimize development processes, procedures, and overall organizational efficiency.

  • Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills, capable of articulating complex architectural and AI workflow concepts clearly to both deeply technical peers and executive leadership.

  • Cloud & IaC Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with GCP (or equivalent major cloud providers) and deep architectural experience with Terraform.

  • Advanced Container Orchestration: Deep, internal knowledge of virtualized and containerized environments, with architectural-level expertise in scaling Kubernetes, extending it via custom operators, and automating complex operational logic.

  • Software Engineering Approach: Advanced coding and automation skills in Python or Go. You treat infrastructure as a software engineering discipline and can build custom tooling/services when off-the-shelf solutions fall short.

  • Proven Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-team technical initiatives from conception to delivery, including setting technical roadmaps and driving consensus among stakeholders.

  • OS/Systems Expertise: Mastery of Linux systems, including kernel tuning, advanced networking, and performance troubleshooting.

Nice to Have:

  • Deep expertise in managing and scaling stateful workloads and distributed databases (e.g., Cassandra, ScyllaDB, MemSQL, or MySQL) in containerized environments.

  • Experience contributing to open-source infrastructure projects, or presenting at major tech conferences.


 

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at  accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

Job Summary

Your Career

In enterprise cybersecurity, data is king - but only if you can ingest it, orchestrate it, and act on it instantly.

As a visionary, technically sharp Senior Product Management Leader, you will own the foundational engine of the Cortex platform. In this high-impact role, you will lead a dedicated team consisting of a Product Manager (PM) and a Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) to build a seamless, world-class ecosystem of 1st and 3rd-party integrations, out-of-the-box security content (playbooks, packs), and a thriving Cortex Marketplace. You will be driving the strategy for how our customers onboard, connect their entire security stack, and automate their defenses at scale.

Your Impact

  • Lead & Mentor: Manage and scale a high-impact team, providing strategic product direction to your Product Manager and technical/go-to-market guidance to your Technical Marketing Engineer.

  • Own the Cortex Ecosystem: Define the vision and roadmap for our 1st and 3rd-party connector strategy, ensuring flawless data ingestion, integrity, and depth across the platform.

  • Supercharge Automation & Content: Drive the lifecycle of high-value platform content—including automated playbooks, integration packs, and streamlined onboarding workflows that turn complex security data into immediate value.

  • Scale the Marketplace: Treat our Marketplace as a strategic product lever, maximizing the velocity, quality, and adoption of community and partner integrations.

  • Drive Platform-Wide Synergy: Act as a central bridge, collaborating closely with Engineering, Security Research, and peer PMs across XSIAM and Cortex modules (XDR, Cortex Cloud, Exposure Management) to deliver a unified, elite security experience.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Proven Leader: At least 5 years of Product Management experience, including a minimum of 2 years successfully managing and coaching team members (PMs, TMEs, or closely related technical roles).

  • Cybersecurity Native: A solid background in cybersecurity from at least one of your previous positions.

​

Preferred Qualifications

  • Domain Expertise: Hands-on experience in SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response) or SIEM environments, with a strong preference for product management experience in these areas. You know what makes an automated playbook effective and why seamless integration matters.

  • Integration Champion: A proven track record of managing complex 3rd-party integrations, navigating external vendor/partner ecosystems, and building developer-friendly APIs.

  • SecOps & Workflow Knowledge: A deep understanding of SecOps workflows and how security analysts operate daily.

  • Ecosystem Thinker: You look at platforms holistically and understand how to bridge the gap between core product strategy (PM) and technical enablement, validation, and content creation (TME).

Why This Role is Exciting

At the Center of Everything: You and your team sit at the critical intersection of Engineering, Security Research, and Customer Success. Every major feature across XSIAM, XDR, and Cortex Cloud relies on the data pipelines and content frameworks your team creates. If you love high visibility, scaling people, and building ecosystem-level products, this is your next career-defining role.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at  accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Principal Software Architect to define and drive the long-term architectural vision for our Identity Platform. In this role, you will lead the design and evolution of our next-generation Identity services, ensuring they meet the highest standards of scalability, security, resiliency, and operational excellence. As one of the organization's senior technical leaders, you will shape architecture across multiple product areas, influence strategic technology decisions, and partner with Engineering, Product Management, Security, and Architecture leadership to build a world-class Identity platform. You will establish architectural standards, mentor engineering teams and architects, and drive modernization initiatives that accelerate innovation while reducing technical debt.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve the long-term architecture and technology strategy for the Identity Platform.
  • Lead the design of large-scale, cloud-native SaaS systems that meet demanding scalability, security, availability, and performance requirements.
  • Establish architectural principles, design standards, and engineering best practices across multiple teams and organizations.
  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Security, and fellow architects to translate business and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Drive modernization initiatives, simplify complex systems, and strategically reduce technical debt.
  • Lead architecture reviews, identify technical risks, and guide teams toward successful implementation.
  • Mentor architects and senior engineers, fostering technical excellence and growing future technical leaders.
  • Represent the Identity organization in architecture forums and contribute to the broader engineering strategy across Palo Alto Networks.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including several years in software architecture or principal engineering roles.
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering large-scale cloud-native SaaS platforms.
  • Strong understanding of AI security, prompt injection defenses, privacy considerations, and cost-management models in cloud environments.
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, asynchronous architectures, and enterprise software design patterns.
  • Strong programming background in .NET, Java, Python, Go, or similar technologies.
  • Extensive experience with AWS (preferred) or Azure cloud architectures.
  • Demonstrated experience leading architecture for multiple enterprise-scale products from concept through production.
  • Strong understanding of scalability, resiliency, observability, security, and non-functional requirements.
  • Excellent communication, technical writing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence executive and engineering leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM), including Directory Services, Authentication, Authorization, SSO, OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, and RBAC/ABAC.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure-as-Code, and modern CI/CD platforms.
  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms and operating services at global scale.
  • Strong background in Agile software development and iterative architecture practices.
  • Experience mentoring architects and leading cross-organizational technical initiatives.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Group Manager to lead our Directory Services group within the Identity organization. In this key leadership position, you will manage and inspire engineering teams spread across multiple geographies, driving one of the foundational, mission-critical services of our Identity platform. Directory Services sits at the heart of our security and identity ecosystem, serving as the high-scale foundation for user authentication, enterprise directory integration, and data sync across enterprise environments. As a manager of managers, you will be responsible for defining the technical and operational vision, scaling high-availability distributed systems, nurturing talent across global offices, and ensuring our identity infrastructure meets the rigorous security and reliability demands of enterprise customers worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

  • Multi-Geo People & Organizational Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow team managers and senior technical leaders across global geographies. Scale the group through strategic recruitment, team structuring, and proactive talent development.
  • Service Vision & Strategy: Own the vision, engineering execution, and strategic roadmap for Directory Services—one of Identity’s key foundational pillars.
  • Scale, Reliability & Security: Ensure ultra-high availability, low-latency performance, seamless scalability and robust security standards.
  • Cross-Organizational Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Security Architects and multiple R&D units.
  • Rapid & Critical Incident Response: Lead cross-regional response to high-priority operational or security events related to directory environments, driving rapid resolution and long-term systemic mitigations.
  • Thought Leadership in IAM: Stay at the forefront of modern Identity & Access Management (IAM) practices and enterprise directory protocols.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • At least 4+ years of experience as a Group Manager or Manager of Managers with a proven track record of leading engineering managers.
  • At least 8+ years of overall software engineering management experience.
  • At least 5+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM), enterprise security, or large-scale core platform engineering.
  • Demonstrated background in building and operating high-scale, high-availability (HA) distributed systems.
  • Strong technical foundation in backend engineering (e.g., Java, Go, C#, Python) with a strong architectural vision.
  • Experience managing multi-tenant SaaS identity platform services at scale.
  • Hands-on leadership approach—able to engage deeply in strategic architectural discussions while maintaining high-level oversight.
  • Proven success driving cross-functional alignment, setting high quality standards, and consistently meeting critical deadlines.
  • Strong passion for people leadership: coaching, mentoring managers, building high-performing team cultures, and retaining top talent.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex architectural strategies and plans clearly to executive leadership and global stakeholders.
  • A resilient, 'play-to-win' mindset with the ability to prioritize and execute under pressure in high-growth environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep domain knowledge in Directory Services & Protocols (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP, SCIM, cloud directory synchronization, identity stores).
  • Proven experience managing geographically distributed (multi-geo) engineering teams.
  • Experience modernizing legacy directory architectures into scalable, cloud-native directory services (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID / AWS Directory Service / hybrid identity models).

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Job Summary

In this role, you will be dedicated to safeguarding our clients’ data within the dynamic cloud landscape. As an expert in Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) for SaaS and DBaaS, you will develop cutting-edge solutions for data discovery, classification, and protection across platforms like Snowflake, Databricks and MongoDB Atlas. Your work will focus on proactively identifying and eliminating risks, ensuring our clients' sensitive information remains secure, compliant, and accessible only to authorized users, empowering them to grow their business securely.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive innovation by designing and implementing impactful solutions that address client needs, contributing to the full feature development lifecycle from design to deployment.

  • Take ownership of specific feature segments, ensuring high-quality code and robust functionality through meticulous attention to detail and a focus on execution.

  • Proactively collaborate and exchange information with cross-functional teams, including product and infrastructure, to ensure seamless integration and alignment on shared objectives.

  • Challenge the status quo by generating innovative ideas and actively participating in brainstorming sessions to foster product and architectural improvements.

  • Actively engage in technical discussions, openly sharing knowledge and learning from others to solve complex problems and elevate team expertise.

  • Design and build highly scalable, resilient, and secure cloud-based applications and microservices.

  • Contribute to an agile and dynamic engineering culture, demonstrating a strong drive and outstanding communication skills to deliver results efficiently.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience.

  • Proven experience designing and building large-scale, scalable cloud-based applications.

  • Expertise in microservices architecture, including technologies like Kubernetes, Docker, GKE, EKS, or AKS.

  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and ORMs (e.g., JPA, Hibernate).

  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Java or Kotlin with Spring Boot.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure automation.

  • Experience with big-data architectures and technologies.

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity, information security, and software security principles.

Job Summary

Your Career

This role is ideal for experienced backend engineers (ideally with strong Python skills) looking to transition into program leadership.You must thrive in a fast-paced environment and bring a proven track record of designing, building, and operating AI agents or agentic workflows.

We are at a pivotal point in our journey, transforming how we deliver product integrations—the core of our platform—by shifting from manual engineering to AI-first workflows powered by agents and agentic pipelines.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead this transformation. You will collaborate closely with Customers, Partners, Product, and Engineering to scope and design integrations with IT and security tools. Simultaneously, you will redefine the entire integration lifecycle—using AI to automate how customer requests are analyzed, connector designs are created, and software is delivered from early access through full launch.

Your Impact

  • Lead AI Workflow Transformation: Drive the evolution of key business and engineering workflows from manual execution to AI-first, agent-driven processes.

  • Design & Scale Agentic Pipelines: Build, deploy, and continuously optimize multi-agent workflows that automate the lifecycle of integration requests—from intake and API requirement analysis to automated design generation, code reviews, and validation.

  • Drive Technical Integration Scoping: Work closely with Customers, External Partners, Business Development, Product, and Security Architects to scope use cases and create technical design requirements for third-party IT and security integrations.

  • Enhance Engineering Productivity: Improve developer throughput and software quality by integrating AI-powered tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, OpenAI APIs) and agentic knowledge systems into the daily engineering lifecycle.

  • End-to-End Program Ownership: Support cross-functional teams throughout the full software development lifecycle of integrations, establishing scalable operational engineering processes to transition projects seamlessly from early access through full launch.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with cross-functional peers to align solutions, resolve conflicts, clear operational bottlenecks, and drive complex technical issues to resolution.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical program management with strong software engineering background, backend software engineering, or technical product ownership leading software development initiatives and technical programs.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building, operating, or experimenting with AI agents and/or agentic pipelines, with a deep understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, and workflow orchestration.

  • Solid background in third-party APIs and integrations, including proven experience writing technical design and requirements documents for engineering teams.

  • Thorough, end-to-end understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) from initial intake and scoping through delivery.

  • Familiarity with scripting, debugging, or software development (preferably Python).

  • Practical understanding with at least one major cloud platform (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).

  • Excellent communication, organizational, and influencing skills with a proven ability to self-start, resolve conflicts, and thrive in a fast-paced environment with little direct supervision.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at  accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

Job Summary

Own the internal DevEx platform roadmap backlog, translating organizational strategy and R&D needs into prioritized initiatives that deliver measurable value across the R&D organization. Work closely with internal customers within R&D, aligning tightly with the External developer PM

Key Responsibilities

  • Requirement Definition (the core of the role): Create and own the requirements for the platform solutions we build for our developers. You continuously synthesize and prioritize four inputs into a clear, coherent product direction:
  • Strategic priorities — the direction set with the Chief Architect on where platform investment should go.
  • Organizational needs — the recurring challenges and demands surfaced by R&D divisions and their leadership.
  • User feedback — direct input from the internal developers who use the platform day to day.
  • Architectural guidance — professional input from Architects, both within the Chief Architect Office and across the product-specific architecture teams.
  • Platform Product Ownership: Serve as the product lead for the internal platforms and tools our engineering teams build for our developers — for example, our agentic developer platform, among a growing set of developer-experience capabilities. Define what each should do and the outcomes it should deliver, and keep the portfolio aligned to a shared vision.
  • Prioritization & Roadmap: Maintain a clear, well-reasoned view of what matters most and why, so platform teams always know what to build next and the organization understands the rationale.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive the work processes that turn inputs into shipped platform capabilities, partnering across engineering managers, directors, and architects. Set direction, align stakeholders, and keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Feedback & Impact: Establish durable channels to collect and synthesize developer feedback and adoption signals, feed them back into the requirements, and demonstrate the platform's impact on developer productivity.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • AI-first mindset: You reach for AI as the default way to work and to solve problems, stay current as the tools evolve, and think about how AI reshapes what our platforms should do for developers. As with every role in our engineering organization, this is a baseline expectation, not a bonus.
  • Development expertise: Deep understanding of software development and development processes, grounded in hands-on experience — most likely as an engineer, engineering leader, or architect, though what matters is genuine fluency in how developers work and what they need.
  • Passion for building products: A real drive to build products — to focus on impact and the broad scheme of things, define the what and the why, and leave the implementation details to the teams that own them. This is what sets the role apart, and it is what we are explicitly selecting for.
  • Platform experience: Experience building or shaping internal platforms and developer tools — whether as a developer, an engineering manager, or a product lead. The perspective matters more than the prior title.
  • Seniority & independence: Proven ability to set an agenda, operate autonomously, and manage work processes that span multiple functions — engineering managers, directors, and architects — with minimal supervision.
  • Agile mindset: Comfort with iteration, continuous learning, and adjusting direction as you gather evidence; you make progress amid ambiguity rather than waiting for perfect information.
  • Passion & curiosity: A genuine curiosity that drives continuous learning — about developers, technologies, and how to make an organization more effective.
  • Cross-functional influence: Able to influence without authority and to align senior stakeholders around shared priorities.
  • Communication: Excellent communication, presentation, and prioritization skills, with fluent English.
  • Working at altitude: Able to engage directors and managers at the right level of detail, trusting expert teams with strong context, without descending into low-level implementation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Product Lead, Product Manager, or Engineering Manager, particularly for internal platforms, developer tools, or platform-as-a-product initiatives.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI, AI-assisted development tools, and modern developer productivity practices.
  • Experience with CI/CD, cloud-native infrastructure, and SaaS development at scale.
  • Experience defining and tracking KPIs to demonstrate measurable productivity impact.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at  accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Job Summary

Are you an Technical Enablement Engineer? ready to translate raw model output into a reliable, high-quality production system? Do you excel at the craft of Prompt Engineering and thrive on the challenge of ensuring Generative AI output meets rigorous quality standards in mission-critical applications?

Join our R&D Operations Team. You will be the Technical Enablement Engineer  responsible for the end-to-end quality, performance, and operational tuning of our Generative AI-driven support system (“Co-Pilot”). Your mission is to actively shape the model's intelligence, govern the data it uses, and implement the mechanisms that guarantee its accuracy, directly accelerating our customer support engineering velocity.

Your Impact

  • Support & Customer Advocacy: Champion the Support Journey in Engineering. Develop in-product support instructions that reflect and address real incoming cases, enhancing the quality and effectiveness of AI feature solutions.

  • Model Quality Validation: Use existing evaluation platforms and methodologies to validate production models. Monitor quality metrics to continuously assess and rank AI answers for accuracy and reliability.

  • Prompt Engineering & CT Loop: Drive the Continuous Training loop through systematic prompt engineering (refining and versioning inputs). Analyze failures to define R&D actions or features needed to close model performance gaps.

  • AI Knowledge Governance: Act as AI Content Governor, implementing controls to verify and ingest compliant knowledge base content, ensuring a quality data source.

  • Cross-Functional SME: Serve as the AI Support Co-pilot Subject Matter Expert, partnering with R&D and Support Enablement to translate quality issues into core model logic improvements and feature development.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5+ years of professional experience in Support Enablement: Demonstrated experience in a Support Enablement, Customer Success, or Technical Support Content role, with a strong operational understanding of Customer Support workflows and knowledge base management/optimization.

  • Analytical Skills: Proven ability to analyze support data and provide actionable insights

  • AI/ML/LLM Foundation: Possesses a high-level understanding of AI tools, LLMs, machine learning, and applicative AI principles.

  • Technical Communication: Strong skills in translating observed model performance issues and Agentic Action requirements into clear, prioritized technical requirements for R&D teams.

  • Ownership: A dedicated individual who takes full responsibility for their work, driving projects to successful completion.

  • Data/Content Governance: Experience with data validation, content management, and implementing data governance standards, especially for knowledge bases feeding AI systems.

Advantage

  • Prompt Engineering: Proven expertise in systematically authoring, testing, and refining instructional inputs to drive specific model behavior.

  • Cloud Technologies: Experience with Cloud platforms like GCP, Kubernetes and containers

  • Experience with cloud cyber security technologies

  • Experience with Bigquery

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at  accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

Job Summary

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Your Career

As the Director of Product Management for Cortex XDR, you will take the helm of our industry-leading endpoint security platform. Cortex XDR is responsible for helping customers secure their devices and workloads across their endpoint and cloud environments, stopping advanced threats before they compromise the organization. Endpoints and cloud infrastructure are the foundational attack vectors for modern adversaries.

We are looking for a strategic, decisive leader who can design, build, and ship industry-defining products to help SOC teams protect their organization's most valuable assets. You will drive the platform's vision, align cross-functional teams, and ensure our products continue to deliver top-tier threat detection and prevention capabilities.

Your Impact

  • Lead and mentor a high-performing product management group, driving the entire product lifecycle from ideation to launch.
  • Define and own the product roadmap for Cortex XDR, ensuring alignment with the broader Cortex strategy and Go-To-Market (GTM) motions.
  • Bring innovative, disruptive approaches to endpoint security, prioritizing features and making critical trade-offs to deliver a world-class platform.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, UX/UI design, marketing, and sales teams to drive product development and execute seamless launches.
  • Engage directly with key customers and partners to understand their pain points, gather feedback, and take the solutions you define to market.
  • Establish key performance indicators (KPIs), track product performance, and drive operational rigor across the product portfolio.
  • Evangelize Cortex XDR internally and externally, serving as a thought leader at industry events and executive briefings.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 8+ years of product management experience in cybersecurity or enterprise-grade cloud-based solutions, with at least 5 years leading high-performance PM teams.
  • Deep understanding of endpoint security, cloud workloads, and threat detection methodologies. Prior leadership experience in B2B/Enterprise product management at large organizations or innovative startups is highly preferred.
  • Proven track record of bringing complex, technical products to market at scale.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to define pricing, packaging, and GTM strategies.
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, another engineering/technical degree, MBA, or equivalent military experience required.
  • Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills. Ability to speak confidently in front of major customers and executives.
  • High proficiency in both English and Hebrew is required.

Your Attitude

  • Strategic and decisive leadership style with a strong sense of ownership and a take-charge attitude.
  • Pragmatic and direct—focused on driving results, solving problems, and removing blockers for your team.
  • Passionate about cybersecurity and inherently driven to design new, innovative solutions.
  • A collaborative team player with a "can-do" mentality who thrives in a highly dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Qualifications

Our Commitment

As a Principal Data Engineer, you will be integral to the security research group, designing, building, and maintaining the data pipelines and data frameworks that are the backbone of our cyber attack detection capabilities. Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of end-to-end, complex data pipelines and data platforms in cloud environment.

  • Collect, analyze, and translate complex data requirements from various stakeholders including data analysts, developers, and Cyber security researchers.

  • Develop robust, scalable Cloud based data solutions using Python and distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Beam (Dataflow) , GKE , Spark , etc.

  • Utilize AI as part of the development cycle, including generating, reviewing, and testing code via prompts.

  • Model and manage data within cloud MPP databases and data lakes such as BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years experience as a Senior Data Engineer / Data engineer lead (Hands-On) / Data architect  - working with Cloud environments 

  • Experience in leading and implementing end to end complex Data pipelines and data platforms

  • Experience with collecting , analyzing and syncing complex data requirements from various data users such as: Data Analysts , Developers , Researchers and Managers

  • 4+ years Experience with Data Modeling using various Data platforms and databases

  • 4+ years Python experience - focused on Data related areas and distributed processing (Experience with at least one of the following:
    Spark, GCP DataFlow (Apache Beam), GKE , etc)

  • Experience with Docker & Kubernetes / GKE

  • 4+ Years experience with Cloud MPP Databases / Data Lakes such as: BigQuery , Redshift , Snowflake , Azure SQL DWH , Azure Kusto

  • Fluent with SQL

AI:

  • Using AI as part of the development cycle is second nature for you.

  • Experience generating code via Prompts and closing the loop by reviewing and testing

  • Experience writing MCP’s , Skills and md’s

Soft skills:

  • Collaborative Mindset: A team-first leader who believes that the best data products are built through collective genius and open communication.

  • Bridge Builder: Naturally connects the dots between diverse teams—from DevOps to Data Science—to break down silos and streamline data delivery.

  • Growth-Minded: Approaches feedback as a tool for evolution; possesses the grit to pivot and find the "silver lining" in complex technical setbacks.

  • Execution Passionate: Genuinely loves the "how" as much as the "what," finding joy in the pursuit of clean code and the deployment of mission-critical pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • GCP experience

We're hiring a Senior/Principal Site Reliability Engineer to own production reliability for Cortex Agentix Endpoint Security (following an acquisition of KOI Start Up) as it scales. You'll define and operate our SLOs and error budgets, lead high-severity incident response, and ensure our Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure stays stable under growth. You'll also build and supervise the AI agents that handle routine alert triage and monitor tuning, focusing your own time on the reliability engineering that requires human judgment. This role is a strong fit for someone who treats reliability as an engineering discipline and enjoys ownership, incident command, and applying AI to operational work.

Your Impact:

  • Own reliability as an engineering discipline - define SLIs, set SLOs, and run error-budget-based decision-making so "how reliable are we" becomes a number that governs how fast we ship.
  • Own production incidents end-to-end - lead response, mitigation, and resolution for high-severity incidents, and drive blameless postmortems that feed real fixes back into the system.
  • Own the reliability and capacity of production infrastructure as we scale - forecasting headroom, validating scaling behavior under load, and keeping latency and error rates within SLO.
  • Run and evolve Kubernetes environments so releases and infra changes are safe by default across hundreds of tenant apps.
  • Own, build, and supervise our SRE AI agents that triage alerts, review monitors, resolves and summarize incidents. Set and expand the trust ladder that governs what the agents do autonomously, what needs approval, and what stays human. This is a core part of the role.
  • Improve observability and incident response - raise signal quality, cut alert noise, and own the monitoring the triage agents depend on.
  • Eliminate toil - relentlessly identify manual, repetitive operational work and remove it through automation and agents, protecting engineering time for reliability work that only humans can do.
  • Analyze operational data across incidents, alerts, deployments, infra health, and cost to find reliability gaps, capacity risks, and automation opportunities.
  • Evaluate and introduce new tools and AI-assisted approaches, balancing innovation with reliability, cost, and operational simplicity.

    Qualifications

    Your Experience:

    • 5+ years operating production cloud infrastructure, with a strong reliability focus (SRE, or DevOps/platform engineering with reliability ownership).
    • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, Terraform, and CI/CD.
    • Experience defining and operating SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets - or a clear grasp of the discipline and the drive to establish it from scratch.
    • Strong observability and alerting experience in Datadog or comparable platforms, including raising signal-to-noise in production.
    • Proven incident-response instincts - comfortable owning high-severity incidents and a genuine believer in blameless postmortems.
    • Proven ability to own platform and reliability projects end-to-end, from design through production operation and ongoing improvement.
    • Strong troubleshooting across distributed systems, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and live incidents.
    • Collaborative mindset - comfortable working across engineering, security, product, and leadership.
    • Comfort in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where priorities shift but production quality doesn't.
    • Genuine interest in applying AI, automation, and intelligent workflows to operational work - and in building and supervising agents, not just using them.
    • Ownership-driven - You take responsibility for the reliability of the systems you build and operate, from SLO definition through incident command and continuous improvement.
    • Reliability as engineering - You treat reliability as a software problem to be solved with code, measurement, and automation - not an ops queue to be worked by hand.
    • Collaboration - You work effectively across engineering, security, product, and leadership to align on reliability priorities and drive shared outcomes.
    • Innovation balanced with pragmatism - You actively explore new approaches, particularly AI-assisted operations and agent supervision, while weighing them against reliability, maintainability, and operational simplicity.
    • Security mindset - You design and build with least privilege, auditability, and production safety as foundational principles rather than afterthoughts.
    • Clear communication - You articulate reliability, risk, cost, and security tradeoffs precisely to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    Our Commitment

    We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

    We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at  accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

    Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

    All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Job Summary

Join a team redefining cloud security operations across Cloud Detection & Response (CDR) and Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM). Our team operates at the intersection of security, engineering, and large-scale cloud operations. We build products that help organizations detect threats faster, respond with confidence, continuously reduce risk, and secure modern cloud environments at scale. This is an opportunity to help shape the future of autonomous cloud defense by building technology that turns security signals into meaningful action.

Key Responsibilities

  • Help build the next generation of the Autonomous Cloud SOC by transforming detections, posture findings, and emerging threats into intelligent investigation and response workflows.

  • Design and build automated playbooks that investigate security signals, gather evidence, assess blast radius, validate risk, and guide or execute response actions.

  • Work across cloud control planes, identity systems, Kubernetes environments, network telemetry, and posture data to turn signals into high-confidence outcomes.

  • Leverage existing detections, continuously improve investigation logic, and ensure response workflows remain effective as cloud environments and attacker techniques evolve.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years in security engineering, cloud operations, incident response, threat hunting, DevSecOps, or related security disciplines.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience securing or operating environments within Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Infrastructure (GCI/GCP).

  • Strong experience with Kubernetes, containers, and modern cloud-native architectures.

  • Deep understanding of cloud networking concepts, including VPC Flow Logs, Transit Gateways, service meshes, and traffic patterns (East-West vs. North-South).

  • Strong comprehension of identity systems (IAM) and how policies interact with network controls to establish secure boundaries.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.

  • Proven experience with incident triage, investigations, containment, remediation, or formal operational response processes.

  • Experience with posture management, governance controls, or applying security best practices such as CIS Benchmarks and recognized cloud architecture frameworks.

  • Strong scripting or programming proficiency in languages such as Python, Go, or Bash.

  • Excellent communication skills, demonstrating the ability to clearly explain complex findings and facilitate alignment across cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with large-scale data pipelines and analytics platforms such as BigQuery or Dataflow.

  • Familiarity with threat frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Recognized expertise or advanced certifications in cloud security, detection and response, or posture management across Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Experience operating highly available, large-scale cloud environments.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at  accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Principal MLOps Engineer with a deep focus on ML Platforms and Infrastructure to join our Data & AI group at Cortex Research. Our team is responsible for designing, building, and scaling the foundational MLOps and LLMOps platforms that power both our Data Scientists and Security Researchers. You will architect the high-performance core infrastructure that enables these roles to build, train, and deploy advanced AI systems—ranging from optimized Small Language Models (SLMs) to complex agentic workflows and RAG systems. If you are passionate about building scalable compute platforms and automating the full ML lifecycle to solve complex data and security challenges, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Scale Distributed Training: Design and optimize infrastructure for training and fine-tuning LLMs and SLMs, leveraging distributed GPU workloads, efficient clustering, and compute optimization.

  • Automate the ML Lifecycle: Architect robust, automated pipelines for continuous training (CT) and deployment (CD) of models, ensuring a seamless flow from raw data collection to production environments.

  • Build Model Infrastructure: Own the serving architecture for LLMs/SLMs, balancing latency, throughput, and GPU utilization under production traffic.

  • Implement Advanced Monitoring: Establish comprehensive observability systems to monitor live model performance, data drift, and computational metrics, feeding insights back into the automated training loops for continuous improvement.

  • Collaborative Architecture: Partner closely with data scientists and security researchers to productize complex model architectures and streamline their workflows, while collaborating with our DevOps team to integrate with core cloud infrastructure.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Core Engineering: 4+ years experience as a Senior ML Engineer, MLOps Engineer, or Backend Platform Engineer (Hands-On) working with cloud environments.

  • Model Lifecycle Engineering: Hands-on experience managing the technical lifecycle of diverse model architectures, spanning classic ML, LLMs/SLMs, and agentic/RAG systems. This includes engineering scalable data preparation and processing pipelines as well as implementing infrastructure for model training, fine-tuning, optimization, and high-throughput production serving.

  • Distributed Training & Compute: Strong foundational knowledge of Deep Learning concepts (neural network architectures, training dynamics, optimization techniques) paired with proven experience setting up and optimizing distributed training workloads across multiple GPUs (using PyTorch, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, or cloud-native training infrastructure).

  • Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture: Strong infrastructure knowledge within a major cloud provider ecosystem (GCP, AWS, or Azure), specifically leveraging managed AI platforms and services.

  • Python Expertise: Expert-level Python skills focused on ML infrastructure, pipelines, and automation frameworks.

  • CI/CD Integration: Experience with modern CI/CD patterns (such as GitLab CI or GitHub Actions) for automating software and model delivery loops.

  • AI Tooling & Development: Proficient in leveraging day-to-day AI tools and ecosystems (e.g., Claude, Gemini, MCPs, custom skills, and markdown formatting) to generate, review, and test code dynamically within your development cycle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong GCP ecosystem experience.

  • Background in data science or deep learning workflows.

  • Cybersecurity domain knowledge.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at  accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Job Summary

We’re building foundational infrastructure to secure AI agents - including their identities, access patterns, and interactions with sensitive systems and data. This includes designing intelligent, dynamic mechanisms for ephemeral access control, secrets management, and agent/user identity tailored to the modern agent ecosystem.

You’ll help define how agents (both machine and human-facing) authenticate, obtain scoped access, perform actions securely, and leave a verifiable audit trail.

This is a unique opportunity to be part of a start-up inside the company - building the platform from scratch at one of the most cutting-edge intersections of AI, identity, and security.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the design and development of secure, scalable services that enable AI agents to manage their identities, secrets, and access - directly protecting critical systems and data.

  • Take charge of agent authentication flows and real-time access policies, ensuring seamless, reliable just-in-time, least-privilege access.

  • Lead the evolution of MCPs and agentic AI, transforming innovative ideas into systems that define how intelligent agents operate at scale.

  • Collaborate with architects and engineers to shape and deliver high-performance platform components you can take pride in.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code that powers some of the world’s largest and most security-conscious companies.

  • Drive cross-functional efforts with platform, AI, and security teams to gather requirements, influence design decisions, and bring impactful solutions to life.

Supported or led an AI transformation/adoption effort within an engineering team.
Developed and deployed a major AI-powered feature or internal productivity tool.
Built CI/CD workflows or developer tooling that utilizes autonomous AI agents.

Job Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Cortex Platform Application team, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, and operating critical backend platform services used across Cortex. This role is for an engineer who can combine deep platform/backend expertise with strong ownership, practical execution, and cross-team influence. You will help build scalable and reliable services, guide technical decisions, improve engineering methods, mentor engineers, and raise the quality of how the team designs, ships, documents, tests, and operates its systems. The team owns a broad set of platform capabilities, including areas such as application configuration, dashboards and reporting infrastructure, metrics, multi-tenant and MSSP infrastructure, log forwarding, notifications, auditing, access and permission engines, filtering and querying infrastructure, and other shared application platform domains. We are looking for someone who is not only strong technically, but also enjoys joining a high-performing team, taking ownership from within, and helping turn strong execution into repeatable engineering practice. A successful candidate will quickly become a trusted part of the team by shipping meaningful work, learning the team's domains, and helping others move faster. Over time, this person will help the team increase delivery capacity while also improving how work is designed, documented, tested, operated, and shared across the organization. The right person will not act as an external advisor or abstract architect. They will join the team's day-to-day work, earn trust through execution, and help create organized technical influence from inside the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate scalable, reliable, and secure backend services for the Cortex Platform.
  • Act as a hands-on technical leader, writing and reviewing production code for critical platform services.
  • Lead technical design for complex backend and platform domains, balancing long-term architecture with practical delivery.
  • Own and improve core platform capabilities used by internal engineering teams and Cortex customers.
  • Drive operational excellence, including observability, monitoring, alerting, incident response, reliability, and participation in on-call.
  • Improve engineering methods around documentation, testing, design reviews, ownership models, and production readiness.
  • Mentor senior, mid-level, and junior engineers through design guidance, code reviews, production work, and day-to-day collaboration.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, architects, security experts, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams.
  • Help internal customers use platform capabilities correctly by creating clarity, alignment, and practical technical guidance.
  • Identify gaps in systems, processes, and ownership, and lead improvements without adding unnecessary process or friction.
  • Contribute to a calm, practical, low-ego engineering culture focused on ownership, execution, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience in backend/platform software development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with backend development using languages such as Go, Javascript, C++, C#, Ruby, Python, or similar.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems in production.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, data modeling, APIs, reliability, observability, and production operations.
  • Experience working in cloud-based environments.
  • Ability to lead technical decisions while staying close to the code and implementation details.
  • Strong ownership mindset, including accountability for production behavior, quality, and long-term maintainability.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards within a team.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to influence across teams without relying on authority.
  • Practical, collaborative, low-ego working style.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with public cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD systems, and modern production infrastructure.
  • Experience building internal platforms, shared services, developer platforms, or application infrastructure.
  • Experience with multi-tenant systems, permissions, access control, configuration systems, notification systems, auditing, metrics, or reporting infrastructure.
  • Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives.
  • Experience improving engineering practices such as testing strategy, documentation, design processes, incident reviews, or ownership models.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, SaaS platforms, or enterprise-scale backend systems.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at  accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
